_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

sensor_count.basis: optical water level sensors on one node

other_sensing.basis: other quantities the prototype senses, counted in the release's own list

validation_pct.basis: validation accuracy in initial assessments post-training, percent

validation_rest_pct.basis: the part of a 100 percent bar the validation figure leaves, percent, two places

validation_frac.basis: the validation figure as a fraction of one bar, four places

lora_street_mi.basis: miles through city streets, the release's 'more than a half-mile'

lora_open_mi.basis: miles in open areas, the release's 'up to five miles'

lora_street_m.basis: the street reach in metres, one mile = 1609.344 m, rounded to a metre

lora_open_m.basis: the open reach in metres, rounded to a metre

cost_low.basis: low end of the parts cost for one prototype, dollars

cost_high.basis: high end of the parts cost for one prototype, dollars

cost_low_frac.basis: the low end as a fraction of the high end, four places

rain_gauges.basis: rain gauges UT Arlington cross-referenced, 'more than'

radar_short_pct.basis: how far standard radar can underestimate storm totals, 'roughly', percent

radar_fill_frac.basis: the radar column's fill as a fraction of the gauge column's, a drawing rule from the percent

vehicle_share_word.basis: the NWS relay of CDC's share of flood drownings in vehicles, as words, never a numeral

release_date.basis: the publication date the fact check read off the UTSA page and recorded on c1 as published

wet_cover.basis: a drawing rule: the cover's water reaches the first of the four sensors, drawn to illustrate

wet_close.basis: a drawing rule: the close's water reaches three of the four, drawn to illustrate, the fourth never

cost_bar_m.basis: a drawing rule: one centimetre of the cost bar per dollar, so $220 is 2.2 m

cost_low_m.basis: the low end on the same bar, metres

validation_bar_m.basis: a drawing rule: the validation bar is 10 m long for 100 percent

validation_lit_m.basis: the lit length of that bar, metres, three places
